name: MMunhoz Score Quiz
author: MMunhoz

sections.description:
MMunhoz Score Quiz is a complete, lightweight, and flexible WordPress plugin that allows you to create interactive scoring quizzes, diagnostic tests, and assessments with custom point values per answer option.

The plugin features native Bilingual Support (English and Portuguese), allowing administrators to dynamically switch all interface texts displayed on screen (admin submenus, dashboard headers, notices, buttons, frontend forms, and alerts) between English and Brazilian Portuguese with a single click. Custom questions, answers, and diagnostic messages entered by the administrator remain completely intact and untouched.

MMunhoz Score Quiz is fully universal and suitable for any industry: consulting, coaching, education, healthcare, marketing, human resources, sales qualification, audits, and performance reviews.

When respondents answer questions, each option carries a point value configured in the admin dashboard. Upon completion, the system instantly computes the total accumulated score via AJAX (without reloading the page), identifies the matching diagnostic score range, displays personalized feedback on-screen, and sends an automated HTML email report to the administrator and participant.

Key Features:

  • Bilingual Support (English & Portuguese): Easily switch all plugin admin and frontend interface texts between English and Brazilian Portuguese directly in General Settings.
  • Dedicated Left Sidebar Submenus: Clean navigation organized directly in WordPress admin menu: General Settings, Questions, Result Ranges, and Sent Emails.
  • Up to 30 Customizable Questions: Easily manage questions using an accordion interface in the admin panel.
  • Up to 10 Options per Question: Configure from 2 to 10 answer options. Empty options are automatically hidden on the frontend.
  • Custom Scoring per Answer: Assign positive, neutral, or weighted points individually to each option.
  • Custom Diagnostic Result Ranges: Define score brackets (e.g. 0 to 49, 50 to 99, 100 to 150) with customized titles and detailed feedback messages.
  • Integrated Lead Capture: Collect Full Name and Email Address with strict validation before starting the quiz.
  • Sent Emails / Leads Log: Built-in dashboard subpanel storing participant names, emails, total scores, diagnostic ranges, and submission timestamps, with single and bulk delete controls.
  • Multiple Recipient Emails: Send quiz reports to multiple administrator emails separated by commas.
  • Custom Sender Settings: Configure custom “From” sender name and email address for emails sent to participants.
  • Modern & Responsive Design: Step-by-step user interface that adapts seamlessly to any WordPress theme and mobile devices.
  • Universal Shortcodes: Embed anywhere using [mmunhoz_score_quiz] or [score_quiz].
sections.installation:
1. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the mmunhoz-score-quiz.zip file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to the MMunhoz Score Quiz submenus in the sidebar to configure settings, language (English or Portuguese), questions, and email options.
  5. Place the [mmunhoz_score_quiz] shortcode on any page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I choose the plugin language (English / Portuguese)?

Yes. In the General Settings submenu, select either English or Brazilian Portuguese from the language dropdown. All interface labels, buttons, admin menus, and notifications will instantly update to the selected language.

Are my custom questions affected when changing the language?

No. The language setting only translates the plugin’s built-in interface texts (buttons, field labels, admin headings). Your customized question titles, answer options, and range messages remain exactly as you typed them.

Can I send reports to multiple email addresses?

Yes. In the General Settings submenu, simply separate multiple email addresses with a comma in the “Primary Destination Emails” field.

Where can I view submitted quiz leads?

Go to the MMunhoz Score Quiz > Sent Emails submenu. All participant submissions, scores, and dates are recorded there.

Do I need to fill all 10 options for every question?

No. You can provide only 2, 3, or 4 options. Any option left blank will not be displayed on the website.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes. The interface is fully responsive on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
sections.changelog:
2.3.1

  • Renamed plugin to MMunhoz Score Quiz with distinctive brand prefix for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Added MMunhoz as official contributor in readme.txt.
  • Added dynamic interface language selection between English and Brazilian Portuguese (with full grammatical accents).
  • Separated plugin interface strings from user-entered content to ensure seamless bilingual support.
  • Full WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) and Plugin Check (PCP) compliance.

2.3.0

  • Changed navigation from top tabs to left WordPress sidebar submenus (General Settings, Questions, Result Ranges, Sent Emails).
  • Added language selector dropdown in settings.
  • Dedicated subpanel for Sent Emails with lead counter badge in the sidebar menu.

2.2.0

  • Full WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) and Plugin Check (PCP) compliance.
  • Support for multiple comma-separated administrator destination emails.
  • Added custom sender name and email settings for participant notifications.
  • Added Sent Emails and Leads management tab with delete controls.
  • English readme.txt for WordPress.org repository compliance.

2.1.0

  • Universal scoring and diagnostic ranges support.
  • Removal of average calculation to focus on total score.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
